title: Base change of equivalences between quasicategorical isofibrations
statement:
Use quasicategories, simplicial pullbacks and functor equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and isofibrations as defined in [lem-coef-infinity-isofibration-exponentiation]. Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal S$ be quasicategories in a common universe, let $p:\mathcal A\to\mathcal S$ and $q:\mathcal B\to\mathcal S$ be isofibrations, and let $v:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a functor equivalence satisfying $qv=p$ as simplicial maps. For every quasicategory $\mathcal R$ and simplicial functor $h:\mathcal R\to\mathcal S$, the degreewise simplicial pullbacks are quasicategories, and the induced map
$$\mathcal R\times_{\mathcal S}\mathcal A\longrightarrow\mathcal R\times_{\mathcal S}\mathcal B$$
is an equivalence of quasicategories. No fibration hypothesis on $v$ or $h$ is imposed.
